en: to accept and follow a rule or decision
simple: We must abide by the rules.
toeic: All employees must abide by the company safety policy.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的安全政策。

en: a person who manages an organization or system
simple_zh: 管理員修復了我的帳號。
toeic: Please contact the system administrator if you cannot log in.
toeic_zh: 如果無法登入，請聯絡系統管理員。

en: additional information at the end of a document
simple: The detailed data is in the appendix.
toeic: Additional supporting documents are provided in the appendix.
toeic_zh: 附錄中提供了其他支持文檔。

en: to store documents for long-term keeping
simple: We archive old files in the basement.
simple_zh: 我們將舊文件存檔在地下室。
toeic: Please archive this year's documents before the fiscal year ends.
toeic_zh: 請在財政年度結束前存檔今年的文檔。

en: to succeed in reaching a goal
simple: She worked hard to attain her goal.
simple_zh: 她努力工作以達成目標。
toeic: The team attained its sales target ahead of schedule.
toeic_zh: 團隊提前達成了銷售目標。

en: clothes, especially formal ones
simple_zh: 這裡要求穿著商務服裝。
toeic: The invitation says the dress code is formal attire.
toeic_zh: 邀請函上寫明服裝規定為正式服裝。

en: a thorough examination of accounts or procedures
toeic: An external audit ensures compliance with financial regulations.
toeic_zh: 外部審計確保符合財務法規。

en: power to decide, or an official group
simple: The police have the authority to stop cars.
toeic: Only the manager has the authority to approve this expense.
toeic_zh: 只有經理有權核准這筆費用。

en: official permission or power to do something
toeic: Authorization codes are required for all system access.
toeic_zh: 所有系統訪問都需要授權代碼。

en: to give official permission or approval
toeic: Only authorized personnel can approve expenses over $5000.
toeic_zh: 只有授權人員可以批准超過5000美元的費用。

en: a small card or pin showing who you are
toeic: All visitors must wear a badge while inside the building.
toeic_zh: 所有訪客在大樓內都必須配戴識別證。

en: A flat case for carrying papers and documents.
simple_zh: 他提著一個黑色公事包。
toeic: Please do not leave your briefcase unattended at the airport.
toeic_zh: 請勿將公事包留在機場無人看管。

en: A man who works in business, especially as an owner.
toeic: The businessman flew to Tokyo to meet a new supplier.
toeic_zh: 這位商人飛往東京去見一家新供應商。

en: A person who works in business, of any gender.
simple_zh: 她是個忙碌的商務人士。
toeic: Every businessperson at the summit received a welcome packet.
toeic_zh: 高峰會上每位商務人士都收到一份歡迎資料袋。

en: A cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things.
simple: The files are in the cabinet.
toeic: All invoices must be locked in the filing cabinet every evening.
toeic_zh: 所有發票每晚都必須鎖在檔案櫃裡。

en: Not paying enough attention to what you do.
simple_zh: 他犯了一個粗心的錯誤。
toeic: A careless error in the report cost the company money.
toeic_zh: 報告中一個粗心的錯誤讓公司損失了金錢。

en: movement or distribution through a group
toeic: The document is in circulation for approval.
toeic_zh: 文檔正在傳閱以待批准。

en: A person who works in an office or shop doing simple tasks.
simple: The clerk helped me find it.
toeic: The desk clerk will check you in at the hotel.
toeic_zh: 櫃檯人員會為您辦理飯店入住。

en: A small device for holding things together, or a short video.
toeic: Please attach the receipt to the form with a clip.
toeic_zh: 請用夾子把收據附在表格上。

en: the action of working together
toeic: Effective collaboration between teams leads to innovation.
toeic_zh: 團隊之間的有效協作導致創新。

en: To collect information and put it together.
toeic: Please compile the sales figures into a single report.
toeic_zh: 請將銷售數字彙整成一份報告。

en: the action of complying with rules or standards
simple: Compliance is mandatory for all employees.
simple_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守合規。
toeic: Regular audits ensure compliance with regulations.
toeic_zh: 定期審計確保合規性。

en: to follow rules or requirements
simple: All employees must comply with safety regulations.
simple_zh: 所有員工必須遵守安全規定。
toeic: The department must comply with the new financial reporting standards.
toeic_zh: 部門必須遵守新的財務報告標準。

en: proof that something has been received or is correct
simple: I need a confirmation of receipt.
toeic: Please send a confirmation once you receive this email.
toeic_zh: 收到此電郵後，請發送確認。

en: always in the same way; regularly
toeic: The company has consistently met its quarterly targets.
toeic_zh: 該公司一直達成季度目標。

en: a difference between two statements that cannot both be true
simple: There is a contradiction in his story.
toeic: I found a contradiction between the invoice and the order form.
toeic_zh: 我發現發票與訂單之間有矛盾。

en: to arrange or organize different activities
toeic: The project manager will coordinate all team activities.
toeic_zh: 項目經理將協調所有團隊活動。

en: a machine that makes copies of documents
simple: The copier is out of paper.
toeic: The copier on the third floor is jammed again.
toeic_zh: 三樓的影印機又卡紙了。

en: the final date to complete something
toeic: We must meet the deadline for this project.
toeic_zh: 我們必須趕上這個項目的截止日期。

en: to assign a task to someone else
simple: I delegate tasks to my team.
simple_zh: 我將任務委派給我的團隊。
toeic: Effective managers know how to delegate responsibility.
toeic_zh: 有效的經理知道如何委派責任。

en: to remove something from a file or list
toeic: Make sure you delete old files before saving new ones.
toeic_zh: 儲存新檔案前，請務必刪除舊檔案。

en: giving details about what something is like
simple_zh: 這本小冊子描述得很詳細。
toeic: Please write a descriptive title that explains the file's content.
toeic_zh: 請撰寫能說明檔案內容的描述性標題。

en: written material providing information or procedures
toeic: Complete documentation is required for all processes.
toeic_zh: 所有流程都需要完整文檔。

en: a box-like part of a desk that slides out
simple: The pen is in the drawer.
toeic: Please keep the signed contracts in the top drawer.
toeic_zh: 請把簽好的合約放在最上層抽屜。

en: to make an exact copy of something
toeic: Do not duplicate the report without written permission.
toeic_zh: 未經書面許可，請勿複製這份報告。

en: in a way that saves time, money, or effort
toeic: The new software helps staff handle orders more efficiently.
toeic_zh: 新軟體幫助員工更有效率地處理訂單。

en: by using computers or electronic devices
simple_zh: 你可以用電子方式付款。
toeic: Please submit your application electronically by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前以電子方式提交申請。

en: to raise something to a higher level
simple: They elevate the bed with blocks.
toeic: The training program will elevate our service standards.
toeic_zh: 這項訓練計畫將提升我們的服務水準。

en: to remove writing or data completely
toeic: Do not erase any files from the shared drive.
toeic_zh: 請勿從共用磁碟機刪除任何檔案。

en: in a way that is equal or smooth
toeic: The workload should be divided evenly among team members.
toeic_zh: 工作量應該平均分配給團隊成員。

en: to make something easier or help it happen
simple: I facilitate the discussion among team members.
simple_zh: 我促進團隊成員之間的討論。
toeic: The coordinator will facilitate the workshop sessions.
toeic_zh: 協調員將主持研討會課程。

en: information about how someone did something
toeic: Please provide feedback on the training program.
toeic_zh: 請提供對培訓計劃的反饋。

en: to make something final or complete
toeic: Please finalize the budget before month-end.
toeic_zh: 請在月末前定稿預算。

en: a container for keeping papers or computer files
simple: Put the paper in the folder.
toeic: I saved the report in the shared folder.
toeic_zh: 我把報告存在共用資料夾裡。

en: to say that something is not allowed
simple: The rules forbid food in class.
simple_zh: 規定禁止在教室內吃東西。
toeic: Company policy forbids employees from sharing passwords.
toeic_zh: 公司政策禁止員工分享密碼。

en: talk about other people's private lives
simple: I do not like office gossip.
toeic: Office gossip can hurt team morale.
toeic_zh: 辦公室八卦可能會損害團隊士氣。

en: a diagram showing how numbers change or relate
simple_zh: 這張圖表顯示我們的銷售額。
toeic: Please refer to the graph on page five for last quarter's results.
toeic_zh: 請參閱第五頁的圖表了解上一季的結果。

en: the main office of a company
toeic: The company's headquarters will move to a larger building next spring.
toeic_zh: 公司總部明年春天將搬到更大的大樓。

en: an official document that proves who you are
toeic: Visitors must show identification at the security desk.
toeic_zh: 訪客必須在警衛台出示身分證件。

en: extremely important and needing action now
simple: It is imperative to be on time.
toeic: It is imperative that all staff complete the safety training today.
toeic_zh: 所有員工今天務必完成安全訓練。

en: wasting time, money, or energy
toeic: The old filing system was slow and inefficient.
toeic_zh: 舊的歸檔系統既慢又沒效率。

en: an organization for education or research
toeic: The research institute released its annual economic report today.
toeic_zh: 研究機構今天發布了年度經濟報告。

en: necessary and forming an important part of a whole
simple: Teamwork is integral to our job.
simple_zh: 團隊合作是我們工作中不可或缺的。
toeic: Customer feedback is integral to our product development process.
toeic_zh: 顧客回饋是我們產品開發過程中不可或缺的一部分。

en: to get in the way of something
toeic: Please do not let personal matters interfere with your work.
toeic_zh: 請勿讓私人事務妨礙您的工作。

en: a document showing goods sold and payment due
simple: I issue an invoice to the client.
toeic: The invoice must include all items and pricing details.
toeic_zh: 發票必須包含所有項目和定價詳情。

en: A set of tools or items for one purpose
simple: We have a first aid kit at home.
simple_zh: 我們家裡有一個急救箱。
toeic: Each new employee receives a welcome kit on the first day.
toeic_zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會收到一份迎新包。

en: In the recent past
toeic: Sales have improved steadily lately.
toeic_zh: 最近銷售額穩定成長。

en: Paper printed with a company name and address
simple: Please print the letter on letterhead.
simple_zh: 請把信印在公司信紙上。
toeic: All official letters must be printed on company letterhead.
toeic_zh: 所有正式信件都必須印在公司信紙上。

en: A person who works in a library
simple: The librarian helped me find a book.
simple_zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本書。
toeic: The librarian will organize a workshop on research skills.
toeic_zh: 圖書館員將舉辦研究技巧工作坊。

en: The time of day when people eat lunch
simple: The shop is busy at lunchtime.
simple_zh: 這家店在午餐時間很忙。
toeic: The office is closed to visitors at lunchtime.
toeic_zh: 辦公室在午餐時間不接待訪客。

en: Required by a rule or law
simple: The class is mandatory for everyone.
simple_zh: 這堂課每個人都必須上。
toeic: Attendance at the safety training is mandatory.
toeic_zh: 出席安全訓練是強制性的。

en: a short message about business matters
simple: I send a memo to the team.
toeic: The manager distributed a memo regarding the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理分發了關於新政策的備忘錄。

en: A short written note used in an office
simple: He sent a memorandum to staff.
simple_zh: 他寄了一份備忘錄給員工。
toeic: The director issued a memorandum about the new dress code.
toeic_zh: 主管發出一份關於新服裝規定的備忘錄。

en: An oven that heats food quickly
simple: Use the microwave to heat the soup.
toeic: There is a microwave in the staff break room.
toeic_zh: 員工休息室裡有一台微波爐。

en: To put something where you cannot find it
simple_zh: 我常常把鑰匙放到找不到。
toeic: Please do not misplace the original invoice.
toeic_zh: 請不要遺失發票正本。

en: A short sleep during the day
simple: The baby is taking a nap.
toeic: A short nap can help employees stay focused in the afternoon.
toeic_zh: 短暫的午睡能幫助員工下午保持專注。

en: Clean and well arranged
toeic: Please keep the reception area neat for visitors.
toeic_zh: 請為訪客保持接待區整潔。

en: to inform someone of something
simple: I notify my team about the changes.
simple_zh: 我通知我的團隊有關更改。
toeic: Please notify your supervisor if you cannot attend the meeting.
toeic_zh: 如果您無法參加會議，請通知主管。

en: To leave something out
simple: Please do not omit any steps.
toeic: Do not omit your phone number from the application form.
toeic_zh: 請勿在申請表中漏填您的電話號碼。

en: Not required, but you may choose it
toeic: Attendance at the evening workshop is optional.
toeic_zh: 晚間工作坊可自由參加。

en: Related to how a group or company is arranged
toeic: The consultant will review our organizational structure.
toeic_zh: 顧問將檢視我們的組織架構。

en: a failure in the supply of something
toeic: System outages must be reported immediately.
toeic_zh: 系統故障必須立即報告。

en: shaped like an egg or a long circle
simple_zh: 我們有一張橢圓形的桌子。
toeic: The conference room has a large oval table.
toeic_zh: 會議室裡有一張大型橢圓形桌子。

en: past the time when something should happen
toeic: Overdue payments will incur a 5% penalty charge.
toeic_zh: 逾期付款將收取5%的罰款。

en: to watch and manage work or people
toeic: The manager will oversee the construction of the new branch.
toeic_zh: 經理將監督新分公司的興建。

en: Extra hours worked beyond the normal working schedule.
simple: My father works overtime on Fridays.
toeic: Employees who work overtime will be paid at one and a half times their rate.
toeic_zh: 加班的員工將以一點五倍的薪資計算。

en: written work such as forms and reports
simple: I have a lot of paperwork.
toeic: Please complete the paperwork before your first day of work.
toeic_zh: 請在上班第一天前完成文件作業。

en: list of employees and their salaries
simple: The payroll is processed every two weeks.
toeic: The finance department manages payroll and benefits administration.
toeic_zh: 財務部門管理薪資和福利管理。

en: a machine that copies documents
toeic: Please call the technician to repair the photocopier.
toeic_zh: 請打電話請技術人員修理影印機。

en: to make a copy of a paper
toeic: Please photocopy the contract and send it to legal.
toeic_zh: 請把合約影印後送給法務部。

en: to delay something to a later time
simple: We postpone the meeting to next week.
simple_zh: 我們將會議延期到下週。
toeic: The company postponed the launch due to technical issues.
toeic_zh: 由於技術問題，公司延期了發布。

en: to check a text for mistakes
toeic: Please proofread the brochure before it goes to print.
toeic_zh: 手冊印刷前請先校對。

en: happening four times a year; every three months
toeic: The quarterly report shows our financial performance.
toeic_zh: 季度報告顯示了我們的財務績效。

en: a document showing that something was received
simple: I keep the receipt for records.
toeic: Please provide a receipt for the office supplies purchased.
toeic_zh: 請提供購買辦公用品的收據。

en: a person who greets visitors and answers phones
toeic: Please leave your name with the receptionist when you arrive.
toeic_zh: 抵達時請將您的姓名留給接待人員。

en: a person who receives something
toeic: Make sure the recipient is correct before sending.
toeic_zh: 發送前確保收件人正確。

en: done automatically without thinking
toeic: The grammar test included a question about reflexive pronouns.
toeic_zh: 文法測驗包含一道關於反身代名詞的題目。

en: to repay money spent by someone else
toeic: I will reimburse you for the office supplies you purchased.
toeic_zh: 我會報銷你購買的辦公用品費用。

en: something that helps you remember something
simple: I send a reminder about the meeting.
toeic: The system sends you a reminder before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 系統在截止日期前向你發送提醒。

en: doing or saying the same thing again
simple_zh: 重複練習幫助我學單字。
toeic: Avoid repetition in your report to keep it short.
toeic_zh: 報告中請避免重複，以保持簡潔。

en: to make a copy of something
simple_zh: 我們不能複製這張照片。
toeic: You may not reproduce any part of this manual without permission.
toeic_zh: 未經許可，不得複製本手冊的任何部分。

en: a person who checks or judges something
toeic: A reviewer will check the contract before it is signed.
toeic_zh: 簽約前會有審查人員檢閱合約。

en: to write something again to make it better
toeic: The editor asked me to rewrite the first paragraph.
toeic_zh: 編輯要求我重寫第一段。

en: a story that may not be true
simple: I heard a rumor about him.
simple_zh: 我聽到一則關於他的謠言。
toeic: There is a rumor that the company will merge with a rival.
toeic_zh: 有傳聞說公司將與競爭對手合併。

en: not often
toeic: The printer is seldom used, so we may sell it.
toeic_zh: 這台印表機很少使用，所以我們可能會把它賣掉。

en: a person's name written in their own handwriting
simple: I need your signature on this document.
simple_zh: 我需要你在這份文檔上簽名。
toeic: The contract requires authorized signature and approval.
toeic_zh: 合同需要授權簽名和批准。

en: to be a sign of something
simple: A red light can signify stop.
toeic: The green icon will signify that the file has been saved.
toeic_zh: 綠色圖示表示檔案已儲存。

en: without making any sound
toeic: Please work silently in the library so others can study.
toeic_zh: 請在圖書館安靜工作，以免打擾他人讀書。

en: to make something easier
toeic: The new form will simplify the application process.
toeic_zh: 新表格將簡化申請流程。

en: without problems or sudden changes
toeic: The new system is running smoothly after the update.
toeic_zh: 新系統在更新後運作順暢。

en: unwanted email messages
simple: These emails are spam and should be deleted.
simple_zh: 這些電郵是垃圾郵件，應該刪除。
toeic: Use the spam filter to automatically delete unwanted emails.
toeic_zh: 使用垃圾郵件過濾器自動刪除不需要的電郵。

zh: 惡意；(in spite of) 儘管
en: in spite of: although something happened
simple: We went out in spite of the rain.
simple_zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是出去了。
toeic: In spite of the budget cuts, the team finished on time.
toeic_zh: 儘管預算被削減，團隊仍準時完成。

en: a computer file with rows and columns of numbers
toeic: Please update the spreadsheet with this month's expenses.
toeic_zh: 請用本月支出更新試算表。

en: to fasten papers with small metal pieces
simple_zh: 請把這些頁面釘在一起。
toeic: Staple the receipt to the expense form before submitting it.
toeic_zh: 送出前請把收據釘在費用表上。

en: a tool that fastens papers together
toeic: Do you know where I can find a stapler?
toeic_zh: 你知道哪裡可以找到釘書機嗎？

en: Writing materials such as pens, paper, and envelopes.
simple: I need new stationery for school.
toeic: Please order more stationery before the supply cabinet runs out.
toeic_zh: 請在文具櫃用完之前多訂購一些文具。

en: the act of sending something for approval
toeic: The deadline for proposal submission is next Monday.
toeic_zh: 提案提交的截止日是下週一。

en: a person who directs and controls workers
simple_zh: 我的主管批准了我的請求。
toeic: You should report this issue to your supervisor.
toeic_zh: 你應該向主管報告這個問題。

en: for a short time only
toeic: The office will be temporarily closed for renovation.
toeic_zh: 辦公室將因整修而暫時關閉。

en: a book used for studying a subject
toeic: The publisher released a new textbook for business English.
toeic_zh: 出版社推出了一本新的商用英語教科書。

en: completely and carefully
toeic: Please read the contract thoroughly before signing it.
toeic_zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀整份合約。

en: neat and well arranged
toeic: Employees are asked to keep their work areas tidy.
toeic_zh: 員工被要求保持工作區域整潔。

en: a schedule showing when things will happen
toeic: All project milestones are shown on the timeline.
toeic_zh: 所有項目里程碑都顯示在時間線上。

en: Done without official permission.
simple_zh: 未經授權的人不得進入。
toeic: Unauthorized use of company software is strictly prohibited.
toeic_zh: 嚴禁未經授權使用公司軟體。

en: Not known or not well known to you.
simple: This city is unfamiliar to me.
toeic: New staff may be unfamiliar with our filing system.
toeic_zh: 新進員工可能不熟悉我們的歸檔系統。

en: Not clearly stated or named.
simple: The meeting is at an unspecified time.
toeic: The email mentioned an unspecified amount of additional costs.
toeic_zh: 電子郵件提到一筆未指明金額的額外費用。

en: requiring immediate action or attention
toeic: The urgent emails are marked with red flags.
toeic_zh: 緊急電郵用紅旗標記。

en: In a way that must be done at once.
toeic: We urgently need to replace the broken printer before Monday.
toeic_zh: 我們必須在週一前緊急更換壞掉的印表機。

en: a place where an event is held
simple: The venue is near the train station.
toeic: We need to confirm the venue for the upcoming conference.
toeic_zh: 我們需要確認即將舉行的會議的地點。

en: responsibility for one's actions
simple: Accountability is important in our workplace.
simple_zh: 問責在我們的工作場所很重要。
toeic: Each manager is accountable for their team's performance.
toeic_zh: 每位經理對其團隊的績效負責。

en: a standard used for comparison or measurement
simple: We set a benchmark for quality.
toeic: Industry benchmarks help us evaluate our competitive position.
toeic_zh: 行業基準幫助我們評估我們的競爭地位。

en: a provision for something that might happen
toeic: Contingency plans ensure business continuity.
toeic_zh: 應急計劃確保業務連續性。

en: decrease in value of an asset over time
toeic: Calculate the depreciation for office equipment.
toeic_zh: 計算辦公設備的折舊。

en: to free someone from an obligation
simple: The team is exempt from the new policy.
toeic: Certain employees are exempt from the dress code policy.
toeic_zh: 某些員工不受著裝規範政策約束。

en: honesty and moral principles
simple_zh: 誠正對領導力至關重要。
toeic: The company is known for its integrity and ethical practices.
toeic_zh: 公司以其誠正和倫理實踐而聞名。

en: a standard measurement or unit
simple_zh: 我們跟踪幾個關鍵指標。
toeic: The marketing team uses specific metrics to measure campaign success.
toeic_zh: 營銷團隊使用特定指標來衡量活動的成功。

en: an important event or achievement in a project
simple: We reached a major milestone today.
simple_zh: 我們今天達到了一個主要里程碑。
toeic: Meeting this milestone will keep us on schedule.
toeic_zh: 達到這個里程碑將使我們按時進行。

en: to make something as good as possible
toeic: Optimizing the distribution network will reduce costs.
toeic_zh: 優化配送網絡將降低成本。

en: rules or procedures to follow
toeic: All communication must follow established protocols.
toeic_zh: 所有通信都必須遵循既定協議。

en: to make sure accounts match
simple: We reconcile the bank account monthly.
simple_zh: 我們每月對帳銀行帳戶。
toeic: The accounting team must reconcile all invoices before month-end.
toeic_zh: 會計團隊必須在月末前對帳所有發票。

en: the state of being redundant or no longer needed
toeic: We maintain redundancy for critical systems.
toeic_zh: 我們為關鍵系統維護冗餘。

en: the action of keeping or holding something
toeic: The company has a retention policy for all employee records.
toeic_zh: 公司對所有員工記錄有保留政策。

en: a person with an interest in a business or project
toeic: Key stakeholders must approve the project proposal.
toeic_zh: 關鍵利益相關者必須批准項目提案。

en: ability to meet present needs without harming the future
simple_zh: 可持續性是我們的優先事項。
toeic: The company is committed to environmental sustainability.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於環境可持續性。

en: a standard pattern to be copied
simple: We use a standard template for reports.
simple_zh: 我們使用標準範本進行報告。
toeic: Use this template as a guide for creating your proposal.
toeic_zh: 使用此範本作為創建提案的指南。

en: openness and clarity in dealings
simple_zh: 我們重視溝通的透明度。
toeic: Organizational transparency builds employee trust.
toeic_zh: 組織透明度建立員工信任。

en: the difference between expected and actual results
toeic: Explain the variance between projected and actual revenue.
toeic_zh: 解釋預計收入和實際收入之間的差異。

en: Final or greatest; the best possible.
toeic: The ultimate decision rests with the board of directors.
toeic_zh: 最終決定權在董事會手上。

en: In the most basic or important way.
simple: He is essentially a kind man.
simple_zh: 他本質上是個善良的人。
toeic: The two proposals are essentially the same in cost.
toeic_zh: 這兩個提案在成本上基本相同。

en: Something handed down from the past.
toeic: The founder's legacy is still seen in our company culture.
toeic_zh: 創辦人的傳承仍可見於我們的企業文化。

en: good judgment from experience and knowledge
simple: My grandfather is full of wisdom.
toeic: The manager's wisdom helped the team avoid a costly mistake.
toeic_zh: 經理的智慧幫助團隊避免了一次代價高昂的錯誤。

en: the act of carrying out a plan
simple: The execution of the plan was easy.
simple_zh: 這個計畫的執行很容易。
toeic: Careful execution of the marketing strategy raised our profits.
toeic_zh: 行銷策略的謹慎執行提高了我們的利潤。

en: good enough to deserve respect or attention
toeic: The proposal is worthy of serious consideration by the board.
toeic_zh: 這項提案值得董事會認真考慮。

en: what a person plans or wants to do
toeic: The letter of intent shows their interest in buying the firm.
toeic_zh: 意向書顯示他們有意購買這家公司。

en: the state of being joined together
simple_zh: 團隊展現出極大的團結。
toeic: Unity among departments is key to completing the project on time.
toeic_zh: 各部門之間的團結是準時完成專案的關鍵。

en: only, and nothing else
simple: She works solely for this company.
toeic: The manager is solely responsible for approving the budget.
toeic_zh: 經理單獨負責核准預算。

en: having no end
toeic: The endless paperwork slowed down the approval process.
toeic_zh: 無止盡的文書作業拖慢了核准流程。

en: empty, with nothing written
toeic: Please leave the signature field blank until you arrive.
toeic_zh: 請在您抵達前讓簽名欄保持空白。

en: agreement with rules or a plan
simple: We act in accordance with the law.
toeic: In accordance with company policy, all expenses need receipts.
toeic_zh: 依照公司政策，所有支出都需要收據。

en: the act of dividing or being apart
simple: The separation was hard for the family.
simple_zh: 這次分離對這家人很難受。
toeic: The separation of duties helps prevent errors in accounting.
toeic_zh: 職責分離有助於避免會計上的錯誤。

en: happening sometimes but not often
simple: I have an occasional cup of tea.
toeic: Occasional delays may occur during the system upgrade.
toeic_zh: 系統升級期間可能偶爾會有延遲。

en: very small in amount or degree
toeic: The upgrade requires minimal effort from the IT staff.
toeic_zh: 此次升級只需要資訊人員付出極少的心力。

en: only; completely
toeic: The change was made purely for safety reasons.
toeic_zh: 這項變更純粹是出於安全考量。

en: in a way that appears true but may not be
simple_zh: 這個測驗看起來很簡單。
toeic: The seemingly small error caused a major delay in shipping.
toeic_zh: 這個看似微小的錯誤造成了出貨的嚴重延誤。

en: used to show something matters a lot
simple: Importantly, you must arrive on time.
simple_zh: 重要的是，你必須準時到。
toeic: Importantly, all invoices must be submitted before Friday.
toeic_zh: 重要的是，所有發票必須在週五前提交。

en: without help or control from others
toeic: Each team works independently but reports to the same manager.
toeic_zh: 每個團隊各自獨立作業，但向同一位經理報告。

en: a small round mark
simple: Put a dot on the map.
toeic: Please type your name, then a dot, then the company name.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您的姓名，接著打一個點，再輸入公司名稱。

en: the most important quality of something
simple: Honesty is the essence of trust.
toeic: Time is of the essence, so please reply today.
toeic_zh: 時間至關重要，所以請今天回覆。

en: temporary, used until something permanent is ready
simple: Tom is the interim manager now.
toeic: An interim report will be released before the final audit.
toeic_zh: 最終審計之前會先發布期中報告。

en: showing good judgment and practical
toeic: Choosing a cheaper supplier was a sensible decision.
toeic_zh: 選擇較便宜的供應商是明智的決定。

en: to understand something; to hold tightly
toeic: New staff quickly grasp the basics of the software.
toeic_zh: 新進員工很快就掌握了這套軟體的基本操作。

en: difficult to deal with or needing care
toeic: Negotiating with several suppliers at once can be tricky.
toeic_zh: 同時與多家供應商談判可能相當棘手。

en: able to work or succeed
toeic: We need a viable alternative to the current supplier.
toeic_zh: 我們需要一個可行的方案來取代目前的供應商。

en: a good quality; an advantage
toeic: The main virtue of this software is its simplicity.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體的主要優點是簡單易用。

en: the state of not being able to do something
simple: His inability to swim worries us.
simple_zh: 他不會游泳讓我們擔心。
toeic: The company's inability to pay suppliers caused delays.
toeic_zh: 公司無力支付供應商款項而造成延誤。

en: a usual or accepted way of doing things
simple: Working late is the norm here.
toeic: Remote work has become the norm at many companies.
toeic_zh: 遠距工作已成為許多公司的常態。

en: the freedom to decide; care in keeping secrets
toeic: Refunds may be issued at the manager's discretion.
toeic_zh: 退款由經理自行裁量。

en: A natural way of knowing or acting without thought
toeic: Her business instinct told her to wait before investing.
toeic_zh: 她的商業直覺告訴她投資前要先等等。

en: Based on random choice, not reason
toeic: The manager made an arbitrary decision without checking the data.
toeic_zh: 經理沒有查看數據就做了武斷的決定。

en: Able to act or govern independently
toeic: Each branch is autonomous and sets its own budget.
toeic_zh: 每個分公司都是自主的，自行編列預算。

en: To make secret information known
simple: Please do not disclose the price.
toeic: Employees must not disclose confidential information to outsiders.
toeic_zh: 員工不得向外人透露機密資訊。

en: A tool for measuring or a person who rules
toeic: Use a ruler to measure the width of the panel.
toeic_zh: 請用尺測量面板的寬度。

en: To accept something unpleasant without complaint
toeic: The company will not tolerate late deliveries from suppliers.
toeic_zh: 公司不會容忍供應商延遲交貨。

en: A good reason for something
simple: He has no justification for it.
toeic: Please provide a justification for the extra budget request.
toeic_zh: 請提供額外預算申請的理由。

en: Simple and easy to understand
toeic: The application process is straightforward and takes only ten minutes.
toeic_zh: 申請流程簡單明瞭，只需十分鐘。

en: A quotation or reference to a source
simple: Add a citation to the page.
toeic: The report includes a citation from a government study.
toeic_zh: 報告中包含引用自政府研究的內容。

en: To suffer or continue through difficulty
toeic: The company endured several years of heavy losses.
toeic_zh: 公司忍受了數年的重大虧損。

en: Not enough or not good enough
toeic: The current staff is inadequate for the growing workload.
toeic_zh: 目前人手不足以應付日益增加的工作量。

en: A system of methods used in a field
simple: The study uses a new methodology.
simple_zh: 這項研究採用新的方法。
toeic: The consultant explained the methodology behind the survey.
toeic_zh: 顧問說明了這項調查背後的研究方法。

en: To mark with a check or make a clock sound
toeic: Please tick the box if you agree to the terms.
toeic_zh: 如果您同意條款，請在方格內打勾。

en: Not staying the same or not matching
toeic: The sales figures in the two reports are inconsistent.
toeic_zh: 兩份報告中的銷售數字不一致。

en: A system of ranks from high to low
simple: The company has a clear hierarchy.
simple_zh: 這家公司有明確的階層。
toeic: The firm has a flat hierarchy, so staff talk to directors easily.
toeic_zh: 這家公司層級扁平，員工能輕易與主管交談。

en: The state of continuing without a break
toeic: The plan ensures business continuity during a power failure.
toeic_zh: 該計畫確保停電期間業務不中斷。

en: inside an organization or a body
simple_zh: 我們在內部解決了問題。
toeic: The candidate was promoted internally rather than hired from outside.
toeic_zh: 這位人選是內部晉升，而非外部聘用。

en: to use something in a practical way
simple: We utilize the old room for storage.
simple_zh: 我們把舊房間用來儲物。
toeic: We should utilize our existing resources before buying new equipment.
toeic_zh: 在購買新設備之前，我們應該先利用現有資源。

en: to start a process or plan
simple: She wants to initiate a new club.
toeic: The manager decided to initiate a review of the training program.
toeic_zh: 經理決定啟動對培訓計畫的檢討。

en: happening at the end of a process
simple: The eventual winner was our team.
toeic: The eventual cost of the project was double the original estimate.
toeic_zh: 該專案的最終成本是原估計的兩倍。

en: a person who gives money, help, or ideas
simple: She is a top contributor to the team.
simple_zh: 她是團隊的主要貢獻者。
toeic: Sales in Asia were the largest contributor to our revenue growth.
toeic_zh: 亞洲的銷售是我們營收成長的最大貢獻來源。

en: the act of understanding or achieving something
toeic: The realization of this project depends on additional funding.
toeic_zh: 這個專案的實現取決於額外的資金。

en: an official order or instruction
simple: The boss gave us a new directive.
simple_zh: 老闆給了我們一項新指示。
toeic: All staff must follow the new safety directive from headquarters.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守總公司的新安全指令。

en: as a normal and regular part of work
simple_zh: 我例行性地查看電子郵件。
toeic: Machines are routinely inspected to ensure worker safety.
toeic_zh: 機器會例行檢查以確保工人安全。

en: in a way that is good enough
toeic: The staff were not adequately trained to use the new software.
toeic_zh: 員工沒有受過足夠的訓練來使用新軟體。

en: to believe something is true without proof
toeic: We presume that all invoices have been paid by now.
toeic_zh: 我們假定所有發票到現在都已付清。

en: friendly; leaving or going out
toeic: Please place all outgoing mail in the tray by noon.
toeic_zh: 請在中午前把所有寄出的郵件放進托盤。

en: to say words for someone to write; to control
simple: He will dictate a short letter.
toeic: Market conditions dictate how we set our prices.
toeic_zh: 市場狀況決定我們如何定價。

en: separate and clearly different
simple: The box has three discrete parts.
simple_zh: 這個盒子有三個獨立的部分。
toeic: The report is divided into discrete sections.
toeic_zh: 這份報告被分成幾個獨立的章節。

en: operating in many countries
simple: He works for a multinational company.
toeic: The multinational firm has offices in thirty countries.
toeic_zh: 這家跨國公司在三十個國家設有辦公室。

en: to change a text or law to improve it
toeic: The board voted to amend the contract terms.
toeic_zh: 董事會投票決定修訂合約條款。

en: a system with many rules and officials
simple: Too much bureaucracy slows us down.
simple_zh: 過多官僚作風讓我們變慢。
toeic: Bureaucracy delayed the approval of the new building.
toeic_zh: 官僚體制延誤了新大樓的核准。

en: a book with facts about many subjects
simple: I looked it up in an encyclopedia.
simple_zh: 我在百科全書裡查了它。
toeic: The library has an online encyclopedia for members.
toeic_zh: 圖書館為會員提供線上百科全書。
